comment_box: Hello. I am commenting on this proposal because of the detrimental chain reaction it will cause. Abortion is not only necessary but a right. Our country’s veterans have put their lives on the line for the sake of the people. They most of all should have rights, such as to abortion as a choice in any situation. Not only that, but for it to apply to the families of veterans means a fairly sized vocal minority of the population (veteran families make up roughly 11% of families in the US per RAND) would lose access to a critical part of reproductive healthcare. It is for these reasons that I am against this proposal. Thank you.
text: [PUBLISHED EXHIBIT ATTACHED, NOT SHOWN: DANIEL SCHWAM       MEREDITH KLEYKAMP        KAYLA M. WILLIAMS — Veteran Families (37 pp)]
